# Jest Gotchas

> Known Jest patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Use runTestsByPath for Next.js app-router test paths](run-tests-by-path-for-nextjs-app-router-test-paths.md): Positional paths containing route-group parentheses or dynamic-segment brackets are parsed as regex patterns and can report that an existing test file was not found. MEDIUM.
